ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as

shown on Map No. 7-F in an area bound by:

A line 498.50 feet north of and parallel to West Fullerton Parkway; the alley next east of and parallel
to North Halsted Avenue; a line 461.00 feet north of and parallel to West Fullerton Parkway; and

North Halsted Avenue.

To those of a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District

SECTION 2. ‘This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 2447-2449 N Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60614
